prompt: Working only inside this demo folder, fix three small bugs and make the tests pass. - **New tests:**
  - `reward(4,0) === 4`
  - `slots(3,0) === 3`
  - `heal(100,50) === 100`, which checks the 100 cap

I used one Explore agent to read the files without changing them. A hook blocked its shell commands, so it read the files with the Read tool instead. Everything stayed inside the demo folder, with no network use, commits or other subagents.
